headline: Still the first session. Conservative weights.
note: Yesterday's training didn't happen, so Day 1 moves here rather than skipping ahead to Lower. Nothing is lost — the training week just starts today. Meds were 2/2 and sleep held, which is the part that's hardest to restart.

items.detail: As prescribed. Consistent time of day.

groups.title: Train
groups.note: Rest 2–3 min on presses, 60–90 s on raises. Today's only job is to establish starting numbers — stop 1–2 reps short of failure everywhere.

items.detail: Barbell or dumbbell. Your priority press.
The priority movement of the whole plan — wider delts are the single biggest visual driver. Slow, no swinging.
Weight × reps. Without this, next session has nothing to beat.

groups.title: Eat
groups.note: Two of four anchors yesterday. One light day is fine; the failure mode the plan names is three in a row.

items.detail: Greek yoghurt or skyr + eggs, or a shake with milk
Missed yesterday. Palm-and-a-half of chicken / fish / beef / tofu.
Missed yesterday. This is the one that usually rescues the day's total.
Day 2 of 3. One more after this and you'll know your real baseline intake.
You bought it yesterday — first dose today. No loading phase needed, any time of day.
Held yesterday. Keep it — short sleep measurably suppresses muscle gain.
Not in the hour after lifting — cold blunts the training signal.

groups.title: Setup
groups.note: Creatine and whey are bought — that one's off the list for good.

items.detail: Day 3 and still no baseline. Morning, unflexed, before eating. This is the one thing here that gets worse by waiting — a starting number taken next week isn't a starting number.
As real appointments, not intentions. Mon / Tue / Thu / Fri.
